falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 78% bottom_2024_aug analog is a failed bottom, not an unresolved base. UNKNOWN/HOLD is wrong because the correct call was risk-off, not wait.

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 5% above today's close within 14 days, VIX closes below 13 on the same day, and NYSE cumulative advance-decline makes a 20-session high.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom pattern has already confirmed into a risk-on trend. UNKNOWN/HOLD is wrong because the correct call was long, not flat.

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 40 on any session in the next 14 days, or ICE BofA US High Yield OAS widens by at least 100 basis points from its latest reading.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This is a stress regime, not a contained August-2024-style bottom. The pattern match and HOLD are invalidated; ambiguity has resolved to crisis/risk-off.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
